from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import itertools
import json

def main():
    locations = [
        "central_hub",
        "cultural_exhibition_complex",
        "heritage_preservation_site",
        "botanical_research_facility",
        "interactive_science_center",
        "wildlife_conservation_area",

        "recreational_entertainment_complex",
        "coastal_scenic_area",
        "elevated_observation_platform",
        "natural_cascade_formation",
        "subterranean_geological_formation",
        "protected_ecosystem_reserve",
        "historical_fortification_structure",
        "astronomical_observation_facility",

        "ancient_spiritual_sanctuary",

        "final_destination_terminal"
    ]
    
    L = len(locations)
    start_idx = locations.index("central_hub")
    dest_idx = locations.index("final_destination_terminal")
    
    E_loc = [0, 3, 2, 4, 2, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 3, 2, 3, 4, 2, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, 0]
    T_loc = [0, 2, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, 4, 3, 2, 3, 2, 4, 2, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 0]
    
    corridors = []

    corridors.append((1, 19, 15, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((2, 3, 7, 2, 2))
    corridors.append((2, 5, 9, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((2, 24, 18, 4, 4))
    
    corridors.append((3, 4, 11, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((3, 6, 16, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((3, 29, 28, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((4, 14, 18, 5, 5))
    corridors.append((4, 19, 20, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((4, 24, 22, 3, 3))
    
    corridors.append((5, 7, 13, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((5, 9, 17, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((6, 8, 14, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((6, 10, 19, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((6, 14, 23, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((7, 9, 12, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((7, 18, 15, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((7, 19, 19, 4, 2))
    
    corridors.append((8, 10, 13, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((8, 12, 18, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((8, 24, 27, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((9, 19, 16, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((9, 29, 14, 3, 3))
    
    corridors.append((10, 11, 15, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((10, 13, 20, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((11, 12, 11, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((11, 14, 17, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((11, 29, 29, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((12, 13, 12, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((12, 15, 18, 5, 5))
    corridors.append((12, 24, 22, 3, 3))
    
    corridors.append((13, 14, 13, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((13, 16, 19, 4, 4))

    corridors.append((21, 22, 12, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((21, 23, 18, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((21, 24, 22, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((22, 23, 13, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((22, 24, 19, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((23, 24, 11, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((23, 25, 16, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((23, 29, 20, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((24, 27, 10, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((24, 29, 12, 4, 4))
    
    corridors.append((25, 26, 14, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((25, 27, 20, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((26, 27, 12, 3, 3))
    corridors.append((26, 28, 17, 4, 4))
    
    corridors.append((27, 28, 13, 4, 4))
    corridors.append((27, 29, 18, 5, 5))
    
    corridors.append((28, 29, 11, 3, 3))
    
    A = [(i, j) for (i, j, _, _, _) in corridors]
    C = {(i, j): cost for (i, j, cost, _, _) in corridors}
    E_arc = {(i, j): energy for (i, j, _, energy, _) in corridors}
    T_arc = {(i, j): time for (i, j, _, _, time) in corridors}
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    x = {}
    for (i, j) in A:
        x[i, j] = model.NewBoolVar(f"x_{i}_{j}")
    
    y = {}
    for l in range(L):
        y[l] = model.NewBoolVar(f"y_{l}")
    
    model.Add(sum(y[l] for l in range(L)) == 4)
    
    model.Add(y[start_idx] == 1)
    model.Add(y[dest_idx] == 1)
    
    model.Add(sum(x[i, j] for (i, j) in A) == 3)
    
    model.Add(sum(x[start_idx, j] for (i, j) in A if i == start_idx) == 1)
    model.Add(sum(x[i, start_idx] for (i, j) in A if j == start_idx) == 0)
    
    model.Add(sum(x[i, dest_idx] for (i, j) in A if j == dest_idx) == 1)
    model.Add(sum(x[dest_idx, j] for (i, j) in A if i == dest_idx) == 0)
    
    for l in range(L):
        if l != start_idx and l != dest_idx:
            incoming_arcs = [x[i, j] for (i, j) in A if j == l]
            if incoming_arcs:
                model.Add(sum(incoming_arcs) == y[l])
            
            outgoing_arcs = [x[i, j] for (i, j) in A if i == l]
            if outgoing_arcs:
                model.Add(sum(outgoing_arcs) == y[l])
    
    for (i, j) in A:
        model.Add(x[i, j] <= y[i])
        model.Add(x[i, j] <= y[j])
    
    max_E = 50
    max_T = 40
    
    total_energy = sum(E_loc[l] * y[l] for l in range(L)) + \
                   sum(E_arc[i, j] * x[i, j] for (i, j) in A)
    model.Add(total_energy <= max_E)
    
    total_time = sum(T_loc[l] * y[l] for l in range(L)) + \
                 sum(T_arc[i, j] * x[i, j] for (i, j) in A)
    model.Add(total_time <= max_T)
    
    objective = sum(C[i, j] * x[i, j] for (i, j) in A)
    model.Minimize(objective)
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 30.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8
    solver.parameters.log_search_progress = False
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
        visited_indices = [l for l in range(L) if solver.Value(y[l]) == 1]
        
        path = []
        current = start_idx
        path.append(current)
        
        while current != dest_idx:
            for (i, j) in A:
                if i == current and solver.Value(x[i, j]) == 1:
                    current = j
                    path.append(current)
                    break
        
        total_cost = solver.ObjectiveValue()
        
        total_energy_used = sum(E_loc[l] * solver.Value(y[l]) for l in range(L)) + \
                           sum(E_arc[i, j] * solver.Value(x[i, j]) for (i, j) in A)
        
        total_time_used = sum(T_loc[l] * solver.Value(y[l]) for l in range(L)) + \
                         sum(T_arc[i, j] * solver.Value(x[i, j]) for (i, j) in A)
        
        print(json.dumps({
            "visitor_trajectory": path,
            "total_expenditure": int(total_cost),
            "energy_consumption": int(total_energy_used),
            "temporal_allocation": int(total_time_used)
        }))
        
    else:
        print(f"No solution found. Status: {solver.StatusName(status)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
